input: Find woodworking, blacksmithing, glass, fiber arts, clay and maker camps for kids and teens for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville summer camp 2026 kids woodworking pottery fiber

candidates.name: UNC Asheville STEAM Studio
candidates.note: SkillSet camps include woodworking, woodturning, welding, electric-guitar building, fabrication and costume making, ages 8–17 depending on session.

candidates.name: Corylace Cove
candidates.note: 2026 craft camps include copper, clay and carving, metalsmithing and knife making; teen forge camps serve ages 11–16.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 specialty camps include pottery, blacksmithing, knife making and jewelry; pottery serves ages 10–13 at Haw Creek.

candidates.name: Local Cloth
candidates.note: 2026 teen sewing camps for ages 13–18 cover machine sewing, accessories, upcycling and independent projects.

candidates.name: Firefly Valley Pottery
candidates.note: 2026 weekly pottery camps combine handbuilding and wheel instruction with fiber arts and other crafts at two West Asheville sites.

candidates.name: AVL Clay
candidates.note: 2026 Kids Maker’s Camps offer clay building and studio projects, with sessions for rising grades 1–4 and 5–8.

candidates.name: Claying Around
candidates.note: 2025 kids’ summer art camps include clay handbuilding, pottery wheel work, pottery painting and glass fusing.

candidates.name: Fired Up! Creative Lounge
candidates.note: 2026 five-day morning camps for ages 6–12 include pottery wheel work, clay handbuilding, pottery painting and glass fusing.

candidates.name: Asheville Art Museum
candidates.note: 2026 camps for rising K–12 include fiber arts and mixed-media craft techniques; morning, afternoon and combined sessions available.

candidates.name: Madison County Cooperative Extension / 4-H
candidates.note: 4-H Summer Fun included a supervised sewing camp on July 8, 2026, at the county Extension center.

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: Kids’ craft camps and teen workshops ran in summer 2026; the organization is planning its 2027 summer camp program.

candidates.name: Camp Arrowhead for Boys
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp offers woodworking, blacksmithing and maker projects; 2027 registration is announced.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Traditional summer camp includes wheel-thrown and handbuilt pottery, weaving, felting, basketry, batik and other crafts.
